hint.logarithm: To what power should %s be raised to get %s?
hint.radius: A radius connects the center of the circle to a point on the circle.
hint.diameter: A diameter passes through the center of the circle.
hint.chord: A chord connects two points on the circle and does not have to pass through the center.
hint.segment_outside_circle: The segment outside the circle does not intersect the circle and is entirely on the outside.
hint.fraction_to_decimal: Divide the numerator by the denominator.
hint.decimal_to_fraction: Write as a fraction with a denominator of 10, 100... and then reduce it.
hint.fraction_same_denom: Add or subtract the numerators, the denominator remains unchanged.
hint.compare_fractions: Find a common denominator or convert to decimals.
hint.decimal_operations: Perform the operation as on integers, keeping the decimal point in mind.
hint.percent_of: Multiply the number by the percentage and divide by 100, or convert the percentage to a fraction.
hint.percent_decimal: Multiply the number by the decimal fraction corresponding to the percentage.
hint.price_change: First calculate the amount of change, then add it to or subtract it from the price.
hint.percent_of_total: Divide the number of girls by the total number of students and multiply by 100%.
hint.find_whole_from_quarter: Since 1/4 of the number is 10, the whole number is 4 times larger.
hint.map_scale: Multiply the distance on the map by the denominator of the scale and convert units.
hint.map_scale_reverse: Convert kilometers to centimeters, then divide by the scale denominator.
hint.prism_vertices: A prism has two identical bases, so the number of vertices is 2 * n.
hint.prism_edges: A prism has n edges in each base and n lateral edges.
hint.prism_faces: A prism has n lateral faces and 2 bases.
hint.pyramid_vertices: A pyramid has n vertices in the base and one vertex at the top.
hint.pyramid_edges: A pyramid has n edges in the base and n lateral edges.
hint.pyramid_faces: A pyramid has n lateral faces and 1 base.
hint.cube_surface: A cube has 6 identical square faces. The area of one is a².
hint.cuboid_surface: The surface area is the sum of the areas of all 6 faces: 2 * (a*b + b*c + a*c).
hint.cube_volume: The volume of a cube is the edge raised to the third power: V = a³.
hint.cuboid_volume: The volume of a rectangular prism is the product of its three dimensions: V = a * b * h.
hint.coordinate_axes: The X axis is the horizontal axis, the Y axis is the vertical axis. The first number in (x, y) is X, the second is Y.
hint.read_coordinates: First read the value from the horizontal axis (X), then from the vertical axis (Y).
hint.area_from_axes: Calculate the side lengths by counting the units on the axes, then multiply them by each other.
hint.horizontal_distance: The points lie at the same height, so it is enough to subtract their X coordinates.
hint.mean: The mean is the sum of all numbers divided by their quantity.
hint.median: The median is the middle number in an ordered set.
hint.mode: The mode is the number that appears the most times in the set.
hint.bar_chart: Look at the height of the bar and read the value from the vertical axis (numbers on the left).
hint.largest_pie_sector: The largest sector takes up the most space on the circle.
hint.probability: Probability is the number of favorable events divided by the number of all possible events.
hint.abs_value: The absolute value is the distance of a number from zero on the number line (always non-negative).
hint.opposite_number: The opposite number lies on the other side of zero on the number line. The sum of a number and its opposite is 0.
hint.sign_rule: Sign rule: two of the same signs give PLUS, two different signs give MINUS.
